title: Mera bacha mere
body:
mera baccha mere maula ka azadar bane
<<DIVIDER>>
mai hussaini hoo meri jaan azadari hai
fathe shabbir ka aelaan azadari hai
mera maslak mera eemaan azadari hai
har qadam par meri pehchaan azadari hai
nauha shabbir ka lori mein sunaya mujhko
haa meri maa ne azadar banaya mujhko
<<DIVIDER>>
maine gehwara e asghar pe jo maangi thi muraad
mujhko baysheer ke sadqe mein mili hai aulaad
kaash ye pairawe abbas e alamdar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadqa e asghar e bayysheer hai baccha mera
fidya e hazrat e shabbir hai baccha mera
is ta'alluk se ye mazloom ka ghamkhwar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
zindagi wakf hai shabbir ke matam ke liye
maine aulaad ko paala hai moharram ke liye
khwaab tabeer mein dhal jaye wo kirdaar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
kaash zinda mere har khwaab ki tabeer rahe
mai rahun ya na rahun matam e shabbir rahe
khoon mera mere jazbaat ka izhaar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
marte dam tak bhi kabhi matam e sarwar na chute
haath se parcham e abbas e dilawar na chute
dil se abbas e dilawar ka wafadar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
ya ali keh ke mera laadla ghar se nikle
leke abbas ke parcham ko jidhar se nikle
har qadam manzil e dushwaar bhi hamwaar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
lab e baysheer ki khamosh takallum ki qasam
mere maalik tujhe abid ke tabassum ki qasam
godh ka paala mera qaadim e mukhtar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
merey bache pe zamane ka asar kuch bhi na ho
daar ka khauf zaban katne ka darr kuch bhi na ho
aaena daare dile meesam e tammaar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
<<DIVIDER>>
apne bache ke liye shrh ki wila maangti hai
aamir o fakhri har ek maa ye dua maangti hai
taaziyadar azadaar wafadaar bane
mera baccha mere maula ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jawan hota raha maa dua karti rahi
maa dua karti rahi mai jawan hota raha
mera baccha mere maula ka..
author: Fakhri Meerthi
